about: Popular games to learn UI, character shape and world design from. The app downloads their pictures (Roblox thumbnails, Steam and App Store screenshots, Wikipedia images) into vault/attachments/game-refs on this computer only; they are other companies' art, for study, never to copy or publish.

groups.title: Roblox action, horror, obby and party

learn.ui: Huge bold numbers float off every coin pile; currency counters sit top-left in chunky rounded pills with icons bigger than the text.
learn.characters: Pets are a sphere-plus-ears silhouette: one round body, two features, so 100s read at 40 px. Rarity is told by glow and outline, not shape.
learn.world: Zones are flat tiled areas with a single colour theme each and a gate you pay to open; the next zone is always visible through the gate.
learn.steal: Make every collectible readable from its silhouette at icon size, then use colour and glow for rarity tiers.

learn.ui: Hive and bag meters are big bars at the top; the quest log is a scrolling list of plain sentences with progress numbers.
learn.characters: Bees are one circle plus two wing ovals; each type changes only colour and a face mark, so the swarm reads as a crowd.
learn.world: Fields are flat coloured patches sized by level (bigger, higher fields later), arranged around a central hub with mountains you climb.
learn.steal: Lay out progression as physical height: later areas are literally higher up and visible from the start.

learn.ui: Shop restocks on a visible clock; the seed shop is a big framed card grid with stock counts and a rarity colour bar.
learn.characters: Players are plain avatars; the plants are the stars, with mutations shown by colour, sparkles and size.
learn.world: Each player gets an identical fenced plot in a row along one road, so everyone can see everyone's garden.
learn.steal: Put every player's progress where others can see it from the spawn path; envy sells better than ads.

learn.ui: Giant rounded buttons on the left edge with icon plus one word; hatch animations fill the whole screen with a burst and rarity banner.
learn.characters: Pets are chubby, eyes high on the face, very short limbs; 'shiny' and 'mythic' get rainbow shaders, not new shapes.
learn.world: Worlds stack vertically as floating islands; you rise through them by blowing a bigger bubble.
learn.steal: Celebrate a rare hatch with a full-screen moment and a server-wide message.

learn.ui: Classic 2019 simulator HUD: left column of square buttons, coin counters top, egg prices floating over each egg.
learn.characters: Same chubby pet style as the newer game; compare both to see how the HUD got cleaner.
learn.world: Islands floating above a base world; height is progress.
learn.steal: Show the price of every egg in the world, above the egg, not inside a menu.

learn.ui: Building toolbar along the bottom with category tabs, like a PC builder game; money and park rating pinned top.
learn.characters: Guests are small and many; their mood shows as bubbles above heads.
learn.world: A big empty grass plot per player; the fun is the blank canvas plus a long list of rides.
learn.steal: Give builders a bottom toolbar with categories, a grid snap, and an undo; that is the whole genre.

learn.ui: Almost no HUD; money and a tiny inventory. Teaches through the world itself.
learn.characters: Plain avatars; trees and axes carry the art.
learn.world: One large handmade map with biomes far apart (snow, volcano, swamp), each holding a rare wood; travel is part of the progression.
learn.steal: Hide rare rewards at the far ends of a big map so players tell each other where to go.

learn.ui: Cozy cream and wood UI panels; build menu with clear category icons and price tags.
learn.characters: Customers are generic; staff uniforms show role by colour.
learn.world: Each player builds inside a lot on a shared street, so visitors can walk in and eat.
learn.steal: Let other players physically visit and use what someone built.

learn.ui: Classic tycoon buttons on the floor with price and name, plus a sleek shop overlay with vehicle cards.
learn.characters: Vehicles are the characters: chunky, readable silhouettes (tank, jet, heli) at any distance.
learn.world: Bases around a shared battlefield; every base faces the middle.
learn.steal: Tycoon pads on the floor: price in big text, a colour that shows can-afford vs can't.

learn.ui: Huge income numbers over each base; a moving conveyor of items to buy with rarity labels floating above.
learn.characters: Meme characters with very loud silhouettes and colours, each instantly nameable.
learn.world: Bases in two rows facing a central conveyor, so stealing and defending happen in plain view.
learn.steal: Put the risk and the reward on the same screen: everyone can see what you own and come take it.

learn.ui: The reel minigame is one bar with a moving zone; everything else stays hidden while fishing.
learn.characters: Fish art is large, detailed and bestiary-style; the player is small.
learn.world: Islands with distinct weather and music, each with its own rare fish.
learn.steal: One simple skill minigame done many thousands of times; tune its feel before anything else.

learn.ui: Each booth shows a big sign with raised amount; donation popups are bright and huge.
learn.characters: Plain avatars; the booth is the character.
learn.world: A circle of identical booths around a plaza.
learn.steal: Social proof made physical: show the total next to each player.

learn.ui: One big Roll button; the rolled aura's name and odds (1 in X) fill the screen with a cutscene for rare rolls.
learn.characters: Auras are particle effects around a plain avatar; rarity equals more particles, light and motion.
learn.world: A small hub; the roll is the game.
learn.steal: Print the odds ('1 in 1,000,000') on rare rewards; the number itself is the flex.

learn.ui: Unit cards along the bottom with cost and cooldown; upgrade panel opens beside the unit, not over the map.
learn.characters: Small units with exaggerated heads and weapons, readable from top-down.
learn.world: Lane maps with one path, viewed from high above.
learn.steal: In tower defense keep the map clear: menus open beside, never over, the action.

learn.ui: Bright card frames per rarity; summon banners with a timer.
learn.characters: Meme units with one loud silhouette each (camera heads, speaker heads).
learn.world: Short lanes with a few bends, readable at a glance.
learn.steal: A meme can carry a genre if each unit is instantly recognisable.

learn.ui: Dense UI aimed at older players: unit grids, traits, stats; useful as a 'how much is too much' example.
learn.characters: Units with big hair shapes and strong colour accents.
learn.world: Lane maps themed on anime places.
learn.steal: Compare to Anime Defenders to see how much clutter a young audience will tolerate.

learn.ui: Inventory and crafting panels similar to Minecraft but rounder and softer.
learn.characters: Plain avatars; resources and machines carry the look.
learn.world: Your own floating island, plus shared hub islands for trading and bosses.
learn.steal: Give each player a private home that grows, and a shared place to show it off.

learn.ui: Car shop as a showroom grid with big car renders, price and stats bars.
learn.characters: Cars are the characters; licensed-looking but original models.
learn.world: Your dealership on a lot beside a big driving map, so you test what you sell.
learn.steal: Let players use what they earn right away, next to where they earned it.

learn.ui: One big click-to-win meter in the middle during a match; huge strength numbers.
learn.characters: Avatars with arms that visibly grow; bosses are giant and silly.
learn.world: Zones with a boss to beat at the end of each.
learn.steal: Show growth on the character's body, not only in a number.

learn.ui: Classic simulator column of buttons and big rank titles.
learn.characters: Ninja avatars with glowing swords; ranks shown as names over heads.
learn.world: Floating islands stacked up into the sky; jump higher to reach the next.
learn.steal: A rank title over each head is free status for players.

learn.ui: Simple dig bar and a sell button; depth counter.
learn.characters: Plain avatars with shovels.
learn.world: One plot of ground you dig down through, with layers that change colour as you go deeper.
learn.steal: Make depth visible as colour layers; deeper equals rarer.

learn.ui: Rounded, pastel buttons with thick dark outlines and icons first; money in a pill at the top. Very young-player friendly.
learn.characters: Pets: oversized heads, big eyes set low, tiny bodies; neon and mega versions glow instead of changing shape.
learn.world: A small town with clear landmarks (school, hospital, nursery) around a central plaza; every building is a one-word idea.
learn.steal: Thick outlines and pastel fills on every button; one icon per button, and text only when needed.

learn.ui: Minimal UI: a few round side buttons for houses, cars and avatar edits; the town is the interface.
learn.characters: Plain avatars; roleplay comes from outfits and props.
learn.world: A walkable town on a grid with houses, a school, a police station and a hospital; every building is a roleplay prompt.
learn.steal: In roleplay, each building is a suggestion of a story; give the map recognisable real-life places.

learn.ui: The build mode UI is the best on Roblox: category tabs, item cards with price, rotation and colour tools; study it for any building game.
learn.characters: Realistic-ish avatars; moods are bars and icons.
learn.world: A suburban town with jobs as places (pizza shop, supermarket); your house is your lot.
learn.steal: Copy its build mode: category tabs, grid with snap, a colour picker on every item.

learn.ui: Sparkly pastel UI with gold trim; outfit menus are big card grids with layering.
learn.characters: Very tall, slim, stylised avatars with wings, halos and huge skirts; accessories are the progression.
learn.world: A castle school campus with themed realms, dreamy skyboxes and lots of pink and lilac.
learn.steal: For fashion games, the outfit preview must be big, centred and rotatable.

learn.ui: Large circular side buttons, bright and simple, for very young players.
learn.characters: Plain avatars with lots of free props and pets.
learn.world: A colourful town much like Brookhaven, with more theme-park style places.
learn.steal: Bright round buttons with one icon each are the safe default for ages 6-10.

learn.ui: Clothing racks in the world, a big runway voting screen with stars; the theme of each round is shown huge at the top.
learn.characters: Models with long legs and simple faces so outfits are the focus; hair and makeup are big categories.
learn.world: A dressing room around a runway stage; everything points to the stage.
learn.steal: Give each round one theme word shown huge, then a vote; a simple social loop.

learn.ui: Almost no UI; jobs are taught by the objects (a dough station, an oven, a car).
learn.characters: Plain avatars in job hats.
learn.world: A small town where the shop is the centre and houses ring it.
learn.steal: Teach with objects in the world, not text: a station's shape says what it does.

learn.ui: Almost no UI; voice chat is the game.
learn.characters: Plain avatars; emotes and dances.
learn.world: A hangout map with stages, seats and photo spots.
learn.steal: A hangout needs places to sit, stand on stage and pose; that is the content.

learn.ui: Phone UI for jobs and cars.
learn.characters: Plain avatars; cars are the stars.
learn.world: A realistic small American town with roads designed for driving roleplay.
learn.steal: Real-life road layouts make driving roleplay feel right.

learn.ui: Team select screen with police, fire, EMS and criminal roles; radio and callout UI.
learn.characters: Uniforms by team; vehicles with lights.
learn.world: A county map with stations and hotspots for calls.
learn.steal: Team roles with clear uniforms give roleplay structure.

learn.ui: Compact skill bar (Z X C V F) bottom-centre, level and bounty top-left, quest panel left; dense but always in the same place.
learn.characters: Avatar plus big effect silhouettes: each fruit has a signature colour and shape of effects.
learn.world: Three seas of islands, each themed and levelled; you sail between them.
learn.steal: Each power gets one signature colour so players know what hit them.

learn.ui: Four ability slots with icons on the bottom; the rest is screen space for the fight.
learn.characters: Plain avatars; character identity comes from moves, camera shakes and impact frames.
learn.world: A compact arena city that breaks under hits.
learn.steal: Impact frames, camera shake and slow-down on big hits make simple moves feel huge.

learn.ui: Almost no HUD; the room number on each door is the progress bar. Items appear in a tiny hotbar.
learn.characters: Monsters each have one rule and one strong silhouette or sound cue (Rush, Seek, Figure).
learn.world: Procedurally chained hotel rooms with clear readable layouts; light and darkness do the pacing.
learn.steal: Use the room number as the progress bar, and give every enemy a single rule players can learn.

learn.ui: Round role reveal fills the screen ('You are the Murderer'); otherwise almost no HUD.
learn.characters: Plain avatars; knives and guns are the cosmetics that sell.
learn.world: Small detailed maps (house, office, hotel) with hiding spots; several maps rotate.
learn.steal: A full-screen role reveal at round start makes the game make sense in one second.

learn.ui: Only a timer and a stage height bar; the tower is the UI.
learn.characters: Plain avatars.
learn.world: A vertical tower of random section pieces in bright solid colours; kill bricks are red neon, so danger reads instantly.
learn.steal: Danger has one colour across the whole game; never use that colour for anything safe.

learn.ui: Clear team colours (orange prisoners, blue police); robbery markers on a minimap.
learn.characters: Plain avatars in team uniforms; vehicles are the characters.
learn.world: An open city with robbery buildings spaced out so driving between them is fun.
learn.steal: Space your goals apart so travel itself (cars, helicopters) is a feature.

learn.ui: Kill feed top-right, weapon level shown big when it changes; very readable shooter HUD.
learn.characters: Plain avatars with big silly skins.
learn.world: Small arena maps with three lanes.
learn.steal: Show progress changes huge for a moment, then shrink them back out of the way.

learn.ui: Only a banner that warns which disaster is coming.
learn.characters: Plain avatars.
learn.world: One island with a few buildings; each round a disaster destroys them.
learn.steal: Announce the threat by name a few seconds before it hits; players love preparing.

learn.ui: Simple item hotbar; chapter titles as big text cards.
learn.characters: Monster has a simple, exaggerated shape (pig head, bat) that kids can draw.
learn.world: Small mazes per chapter with doors needing items.
learn.steal: Horror for kids: one monster with a very simple, drawable shape.

learn.ui: Kit selection screen with portraits; item shop as a tight grid with prices.
learn.characters: Kits with strong silhouettes and colours; teams show by colour.
learn.world: Floating islands, one per team, around a middle island with resources.
learn.steal: Team colours everywhere (beds, islands, nameplates) so you never need to read a name.

learn.ui: One parry button and a big cooldown ring; the targeted player glows red.
learn.characters: Plain avatars, swords and explosion effects as cosmetics.
learn.world: A round arena; the ball is the only thing that matters.
learn.steal: Show who is targeted with a clear colour on the player, not with text.

learn.ui: Realistic shooter HUD: ammo bottom-right, minimap, hit markers.
learn.characters: Tactical soldiers; loadouts as attachment trees.
learn.world: Mid-size realistic maps.
learn.steal: Reference for a 'serious' look on Roblox; most young players prefer simpler.

learn.ui: Minimal HUD, a downed-player indicator and a timer.
learn.characters: Nextbot chasers are flat images on a moving body: scary and cheap to make.
learn.world: Large liminal maps with long sight lines for chases.
learn.steal: A flat image chaser is cheap, funny and scary; lots of variety for little work.

learn.ui: Night counter and task list, very simple.
learn.characters: Each monster is one colour and one shape idea (Blue is tall and drooling, Green is blind and long-armed).
learn.world: An amusement park at night in a single building with zones.
learn.steal: One colour plus one body idea per monster makes them easy to remember and draw.

learn.ui: Distance counter is the main goal; inventory is simple.
learn.characters: Zombies and outlaws in a western style.
learn.world: A train moving through a long procedural western; the train is your base.
learn.steal: A moving base (train, ship) gives every run a direction and a timer.

learn.ui: Night counter big at the top; campfire fuel bar.
learn.characters: A deer monster with a clear silhouette; friendly animal characters.
learn.world: Forest around a campfire; light radius equals safety.
learn.steal: Use a light radius as the safe zone; the edge of the light is the drama.

learn.ui: Building tools on the side; the river of stages has a stage counter.
learn.characters: Plain avatars; the boats are the creations.
learn.world: A long river split into themed stages with obstacles, ending in treasure.
learn.steal: A long linear course with themed stages is an easy progress bar.

learn.ui: Computer hack minigame with a clear progress ring; beast warnings are sound and red light.
learn.characters: The Beast has a hammer and a red glow.
learn.world: Small facility maps with computers spread out.
learn.steal: Teamwork objectives spread across the map force players to split up.

learn.ui: Big round title cards announce each minigame and its one-line rule.
learn.characters: Plain avatars.
learn.world: Dozens of small arenas, each one idea.
learn.steal: Announce every round with a title and one rule sentence.

learn.ui: Timer and level number only.
learn.characters: Plain avatars.
learn.world: Bright themed levels in a straight line, each with one visual theme.
learn.steal: Each obby stage gets one theme and one colour palette.

learn.ui: Lots of ability slots and a big spin menu.
learn.characters: Anime look with huge effect silhouettes.
learn.world: Big open maps.
learn.steal: Reference for flashy effects; too dense for young players.

learn.ui: Arrow lanes with very clear colours per direction; score and combo big.
learn.characters: Avatars dance while you play.
learn.world: Stage per pair of players.
learn.steal: Rhythm UI: one colour per lane, big hit feedback on every note.

learn.ui: Seeker reveal banner and timer.
learn.characters: Players become tiny in giant rooms.
learn.world: Giant-size household maps (kitchen, garage) so hiding spots are furniture.
learn.steal: Make players small in a giant room; every object becomes a place to play.

learn.ui: Health and stamina bars bottom-left; weapon hotbar.
learn.characters: Avatars with medieval weapons; weapon silhouettes matter.
learn.world: Arena maps with traps.
learn.steal: Show stamina next to health so players learn timing.

learn.ui: Glove choice wall in the lobby; minimal fight HUD.
learn.characters: Each glove is one colour and one ability; the glove shape is the character.
learn.world: A floating arena island you can be knocked off.
learn.steal: One silly verb (slap) with many variants is enough for a hit.

learn.ui: Character select with portraits and role labels; ability icons bottom.
learn.characters: Killers are famous Roblox figures restyled darker; strong silhouettes.
learn.world: Small maps for asymmetric chase.
learn.steal: Asymmetric games need each role's silhouette readable at a distance.

learn.ui: Minimal: room numbers and a few prompts.
learn.characters: Monsters with distinct sound cues and lights.
learn.world: Underwater facility rooms; lighting and sound carry the tension.
learn.steal: Give every threat a sound before it appears.

learn.ui: Clean modern shooter UI: round score at the top, weapon icons, crisp fonts.
learn.characters: Plain avatars with weapon skins; skins are the monetisation.
learn.world: Small symmetric duel arenas.
learn.steal: Symmetric small arenas for 1v1 keep matches short and fair.

learn.ui: Story text cards and chapter titles.
learn.characters: Japanese-folklore inspired monsters with masks and long limbs.
learn.world: Narrow corridors, lanterns, traditional buildings.
learn.steal: A strong cultural theme (folklore) makes a horror game feel unique.

learn.ui: Move list on the right with keys; spin for fruit screen.
learn.characters: Avatars plus big fruit-power effects.
learn.world: Arena islands.
learn.steal: Signature effect per power; reuse one avatar base.

learn.ui: Tower hotbar at the bottom with cost; wave counter and base health top.
learn.characters: Towers are soldiers with clear role silhouettes (minigunner, sniper, farm).
learn.world: Lane maps with clear paths and good spots for towers.
learn.steal: Give support towers (farms) a different look from damage towers.

learn.ui: Unit bar at the bottom, upgrade panel to the side.
learn.characters: Anime-style units.
learn.world: Lane maps.
learn.steal: Compare with TDS for how anime theming changes the same loop.

learn.ui: Polished summon banner and unit cards with rarity frames.
learn.characters: Anime units with big effects.
learn.world: Lane maps with themes.
learn.steal: Rarity frames on unit cards (colour and glow) do the selling.

learn.ui: Car shop with big renders; race HUD with speed and position.
learn.characters: Cars as characters.
learn.world: A big city with highways and tracks.
learn.steal: A speedometer and position number are all a racing HUD needs.

learn.ui: Team select (hero, villain, police, prisoner).
learn.characters: Superpowers on plain avatars.
learn.world: City with heist locations spread out.
learn.steal: Heroes and villains as teams turn cops-and-robbers into something new.

learn.ui: Survival bars (hunger, thirst) and a creature selector.
learn.characters: Large original creatures with strong animal silhouettes and wild colours.
learn.world: Big biome map with water and food spots.
learn.steal: Original creature designs built from animal parts read instantly.

learn.ui: Distance counter; car parts menu.
learn.characters: Plain avatars; the car is the hero.
learn.world: A long desert road with stops and dangers.
learn.steal: One long road with events gives a road-trip story.

learn.ui: Minimal: level names and hints.
learn.characters: Entities with uncanny shapes.
learn.world: Backrooms-style liminal levels with yellow halls.
learn.steal: Liminal spaces: plain repeated rooms are scary on their own.

learn.ui: Ability bar with anime move names; score at top.
learn.characters: Players styled after anime football heroes with flashy effects.
learn.world: A football pitch.
learn.steal: Big named special moves turn a sport into a fighting game.

learn.ui: Shot meter by the player; score and timer.
learn.characters: Plain avatars in jerseys.
learn.world: Courts.
learn.steal: A shot meter by the player teaches timing.

learn.ui: Timing bar for hits; score top.
learn.characters: Anime-style volleyball styles as unlockable abilities.
learn.world: A court.
learn.steal: Unlockable play styles add depth to a simple sport.

learn.ui: Fast round UI with score and kill feed.
learn.characters: Plain avatars; knife and gun skins.
learn.world: Small duel maps.
learn.steal: Take a known game's best moment and make it the whole game.

learn.ui: Stylish dark UI.
learn.characters: Anime-inspired races with strong effects.
learn.world: Large world.
learn.steal: Reference for flashy older-teen combat.

learn.ui: Very minimal, moody UI.
learn.characters: Detailed fantasy characters.
learn.world: Dark, atmospheric islands and depths.
learn.steal: Mood and lighting can carry a whole game's feel.

learn.ui: Huge chunky buttons with black outlines and bevelled colour; very touch friendly. Supercell's UI is the industry template.
learn.characters: Brawlers have big heads, readable silhouettes and one prop each; seen from above they still read.
learn.world: Top-down maps with bushes, walls and clear lanes.
learn.steal: Copy Supercell button style: thick dark outline, bright fill, small top highlight.

learn.ui: Elixir bar at the bottom, card hand of four; chest slots with timers.
learn.characters: Units are tiny but each has one huge feature (giant's size, wizard's fire).
learn.world: One symmetric arena per tier with a theme.
learn.steal: Each arena tier gets a new look; progress you can see.

learn.ui: Resource bars top-right with caps; builder count; very clear upgrade timers.
learn.characters: Chunky, cartoony troops with readable roles.
learn.world: A grassy village seen from an isometric view; buildings grow taller with level.
learn.steal: Make upgraded buildings visibly bigger and shinier.

learn.ui: Score and coins top; mission panel between runs.
learn.characters: Graffiti-style kids with bold colours.
learn.world: Three lanes of trains in a bright city.
learn.steal: Three lanes is enough for a runner; keep inputs to swipes.

learn.ui: Level map as a winding path; moves left and goal shown big.
learn.characters: Candies with distinct shapes and colours.
learn.world: A candy world map.
learn.steal: Each piece differs by shape and colour, so colour-blind players can play.

learn.ui: Clean, elegant UI with thin lines and gold accents.
learn.characters: Anime characters with strong colour per element.
learn.world: Open world with distinct regions by culture.
learn.steal: One colour per element across UI and effects.

learn.ui: Turn order bar on the left; flashy ultimate cutscenes.
learn.characters: Anime characters, very polished.
learn.world: Sci-fi space stations.
learn.steal: Show turn order clearly for turn-based combat.

learn.ui: Street-style UI with stickers and bold type.
learn.characters: Stylish characters with strong silhouettes.
learn.world: Urban streets.
learn.steal: UI that matches the game's culture (street, retro TV).

learn.ui: Throw with one swipe; round buttons at the bottom.
learn.characters: Pokémon are round and simple for the most part.
learn.world: Real-world map styled into a game board.
learn.steal: One gesture to catch.

learn.ui: MOBA HUD simplified for kids: two abilities, one ultimate, score goals.
learn.characters: Pokémon as MOBA heroes.
learn.world: A small symmetric arena.
learn.steal: A MOBA simplified to two moves and an ultimate.

learn.ui: Pack opening with tear gesture, shiny card tilt effects.
learn.characters: Card art.
learn.world: Menus only.
learn.steal: Make opening rewards tactile (tear, tilt, shine).

learn.ui: Soft, rounded UI.
learn.characters: Sleeping Pokémon in cute poses.
learn.world: A camp around a giant Snorlax.
learn.steal: A large central character is the home screen.

learn.ui: Big character art behind menus.
learn.characters: Trainer plus Pokémon pairs.
learn.world: Island hub.
learn.steal: Character art as menu backgrounds.

learn.ui: Almost invisible UI.
learn.characters: A tiny sandboarder.
learn.world: Dunes with gradient skies and weather.
learn.steal: Gradient skies and silhouettes for an elegant mood.

learn.ui: No UI at all.
learn.characters: Small mother and child figures.
learn.world: Impossible geometry in pastel colours.
learn.steal: Pastel geometric worlds.

learn.ui: Cute, frosted, candy UI.
learn.characters: Cookie heroes with big heads and edible themes.
learn.world: A kingdom of sweets.
learn.steal: A food theme for every element.

learn.ui: Squad growing on screen.
learn.characters: Supercell characters together.
learn.world: Small arenas.
learn.steal: Show your growing team as a crowd behind you.

learn.ui: Big title cards per round.
learn.characters: Bean-like characters, copy of Fall Guys style.
learn.world: Bright obstacle courses.
learn.steal: Party obstacle courses work on any device.

learn.ui: Roblox's own store screenshots show what Roblox thinks looks good.
learn.characters: Avatars.
learn.world: Experience tiles.
learn.steal: Check how Roblox markets itself.

learn.ui: Hotbar of nine slots; inventory grid.
learn.characters: Blocky characters with simple pixel faces.
learn.world: Blocky world in biomes.
learn.steal: Simple shapes plus texture = iconic.

learn.ui: Card choices of birds.
learn.characters: Birds are one colour shape each with angry eyebrows.
learn.world: Pig towers to knock down.
learn.steal: One colour, one shape, one power per character.

learn.ui: Drag-to-harvest gestures; production queues as bubbles.
learn.characters: Cute farm animals.
learn.world: A farm that fills with buildings.
learn.steal: Drag across crops to harvest them all.

learn.ui: Skill choice wheel on level up.
learn.characters: A small archer.
learn.world: Top-down rooms.
learn.steal: Random skill choices each level-up.

learn.ui: Skill choices of three, evolutions shown.
learn.characters: Small hero, swarms of zombies.
learn.world: Arena fields.
learn.steal: Show evolutions so players chase combos.

learn.ui: Grid battle UI for touch.
learn.characters: Heroes with portrait art.
learn.world: Small grid maps.
learn.steal: Small grids for touch tactics.

learn.ui: Huge GO button; dice multiplier; constant reward popups (study, but avoid dark patterns).
learn.characters: Mr. Monopoly.
learn.world: Board loops.
learn.steal: Study the reward feedback; skip the pressure tactics.

learn.ui: Slot machine as the main button.
learn.characters: Cartoon Vikings.
learn.world: Village building.
learn.steal: Study, then avoid: slot machine loops are not for kids.

learn.ui: Match-3 levels unlock garden restoration tasks.
learn.characters: Butler character as guide.
learn.world: A garden that slowly gets restored.
learn.steal: A meta world that visibly gets nicer as you win.

learn.characters: Tiny sprites; the screen full of enemies is the spectacle.
learn.world: Flat endless fields.

learn.ui: Enemy intent icons above each enemy tell you what they will do next turn.

learn.ui: Chunky, cute UI.
learn.characters: Animal characters with simple faces.
learn.world: A cozy social island.

learn.ui: Phone-style apps for every system.
learn.characters: Simple low-poly people.
learn.world: A small town that expands as you grow.
learn.steal: A phone in the game is a natural home for many menus.

learn.ui: Stamina bar that shrinks with injuries.
learn.characters: Simple scouts; the fun is co-op physics.
learn.world: One tall mountain, procedurally different each day.

learn.ui: Minimal HUD.
learn.characters: Robot heads with big eyes; googly physics make them funny.
learn.world: Spooky mansions full of valuables.
learn.steal: Physics comedy plus fragile loot creates stories.

learn.ui: Retro terminal UI and a visor HUD.
learn.characters: Simple suited crew; monsters with one rule each.
learn.world: Abandoned facilities, quota deadlines.

learn.ui: Task list top-left; big full-screen meeting UI with votes.
learn.characters: Crewmates: a bean with a visor and backpack; colour is the identity.
learn.world: A small spaceship map with rooms named by job.
